items.title: Ballon d'Or winner Kane not named in FIFPRO World 11
items.excerpt: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane has not been named in the FIFPRO World 11.
body: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane has not been named in the FIFPRO World 11.
Over 18,000 professional footballers have chosen their best men's team, with the final 11 being chosen from a group of 26 selected finalists.
Kane, who won the Ballon d'Or ahead of Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe by one of the smallest margins in history, was among the 26 finalists but did not make the final team.
Mbappe, Manchester City's Erling Haaland, Barcelona's Lamine Yamal and Inter Miami's Lionel Messi were named in a Kane-less front four, which also excluded Cristiano Ronaldo and Michael Olise.

items.title: Man Utd will not rush decision on Carrick future
items.excerpt: Manchester United's bosses will not rush a decision over Michael Carrick's future after their 4-4 draw with Aston Villa which leaves them in the relegation zone.
items.byline: Sky Sports News' Rob Dorsett and Danyal Khan
body: Manchester United's bosses will not rush a decision over Michael Carrick's future after their 4-4 draw with Aston Villa which leaves them in the relegation zone.
Sky Sports News understands the club's hierarchy are planning to use the international break to fully evaluate the season so far and reassess their options.
Carrick and the players have all had Monday off after rescuing a late point against Villa on Sunday, but the head coach and his staff are due back into Carrington on Tuesday.

With most players away on international duty and no first-team training sessions planned in the coming days, that has bought some breathing space for a full re-evaluation of the season. items.title: The key questions for Man Utd and Carrick after history-making bad start
items.excerpt: The future of Michael Carrick at Manchester United remains a mystery following the dramatic 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on Sunday.
items.byline: Rob Dorsett, Danyal Khan and Kaveh Solhekol
body: The future of Michael Carrick at Manchester United remains a mystery following the dramatic 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on Sunday.

Ahead of what is bound to be a pivotal international break for Carrick's tenure , Sky Sports answers the key questions surrounding the state of play at Old Trafford. Do Man Utd bosses know where to go with Carrick?
It's unclear if Manchester United's bosses know exactly where they go from here. They will not rush a decision over Carrick's future.
For several weeks, they have been assessing exactly that and considering whether or not to make a change, but they haven't made a decision yet.

items.excerpt: Welcome to The Euro Debrief , the Sky Sports column in which Adam Bate rounds up some of the key stories from the latest matches across the continent. This week: Kane is the assist king Barcelona win in Madrid Inter close gap on Lazio Eleve…
body: Welcome to The Euro Debrief , the Sky Sports column in which Adam Bate rounds up some of the key stories from the latest matches across the continent. This week: Kane is the assist king Barcelona win in Madrid Inter close gap on Lazio Eleven in a row for PSG Weghorst denies Ajax Bundesliga: Kane is assist king

Whisper it but Harry Kane has gone four games without scoring a goal. That has only happened once before in his Bayern Munich career and in that sequence he went off at half-time in one game and came on as a second-half substitute in another. Drought!

It is not an issue for Kane or club because the England captain laid on both goals for his team-mates in a 2-1 win at Mainz that maintains Bayern's place at the top of the Bundesliga table. The Ballon d'Or winner has become the competition's king of assists this season.

His square pass set up the first for Joshua Kimmich and his lay-off left Lennart Karl with the simplest of tasks for the second. Following on from his lofted assist for Konrad Laimer to score against Atletico Madrid in midweek, it is a growing element of Kane's game.

body: Thomas Frank has emerged as a leading candidate to take over as Crystal Palace manager if the Eagles decide to sack Pierre Sage.
Other candidates that Palace are interested in include Frank Lampard , Sean Dyche , Vitor Pereira , Kim Hellberg , Vitor Matos and Tony Popovic.
No decision has been taken at Palace yet, but Sage is likely to lose his position following a seventh league defeat of the season.

Frank is amongst a list of names that Palace considered in the summer. The former Brentford boss is expected to be among the frontrunners if as expected the club decide to make a managerial change. body: A prickly Unai Emery claimed he headed down the Old Trafford tunnel after Manchester United's late equaliser against his Aston Villa side because he thought the match was about to end.

Villa threw away two separate two-goal leads to draw 4-4 with United in a Super Sunday thriller - but the 97th-minute equaliser from Michael Carrick's side, scored by Patrick Dorgu, brought about a strange reaction from Emery.

The Villa manager was seen walking down the tunnel before the full-time whistle, with the match continuing for another two minutes before it ended. items.excerpt: Manchester United scored twice in stoppage-time to salvage an incredible 4-4 draw with Aston Villa at Old Trafford that still leaves them in the relegation zone.
body: Manchester United scored twice in stoppage-time to salvage an incredible 4-4 draw with Aston Villa at Old Trafford that still leaves them in the relegation zone.

Under-pressure boss Michael Carrick saw his side go 2-0 down inside four minutes but they fought back to level before half-time only to disintegrate defensively again early in the second half. Many had departed when they launched their latest improbable comeback.

Joshua Zirkzee swept in what looked like a consolation goal in the 92nd minute and when Zion Suzuki flapped at one final corner, Patrick Dorgu headed into the net to stun Villa.
